successors.name: Liao dynasty (Great Khitan State)
successors.text: the Khitan lands south of the Xar Moron river and east of the Laoha round Chaoyang

ledger.x: 714: 'it took over fifteen years from 700 to 714 before the Tang were able to reassert control over the Khitans'.

wars.name: Khitan rebellion against Wu Zhou
wars.outcome: Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong rebelled in 696 and invaded Wu Zhou lands; 'it took over fifteen years from 700 to 714 before the Tang were able to reassert control over the Khitans'.

wars.name: Ketuyu's rebellion
wars.outcome: Ketuyu attacked the reigning Khitan ruler in 720, ended Dahe supremacy in 730, was defeated by the Tang in 732 and defeated a Tang army in 734 with Turkic allies.

wars.name: An Lushan's Khitan campaigns
wars.outcome: An Lushan 'launched two invasions into Khitan territory in 751 and 755'; the Khitans became vassals of the Uyghurs from 755.

certainty.note: Steppe and forest-steppe tribal lands throughout; no page opened gives a boundary.
